segments.text: Well here at Innovative Laser and Design customers come to the shop and of course they want to see what we're doing
segments.zh: 嗯，在 Innovative Laser and Design，客户会来到车间，他们当然想看看我们在做什么，

segments.text: They're interested in what we're doing and work. We're glad to show them. When we come up to a laser
segments.zh: 他们对我们的工作很感兴趣，我们也很乐意展示给他们看。当我们走到激光设备前，

segments.text: The first thing everybody wants to do is they want to get ready. Throw the disconnect switch here. Spend time thinking
segments.zh: 大家首先想做的就是准备就绪，拉下这里的断路开关，花时间琢磨它。
